summary: Variant information block for Buy Box controlling how product variants are displayed.
features: Group by color or size display options
Off-canvas variant selection with color swatches
Customizable discount flag and pricing display
shortDescription: The Variant Information block controls how product variants appear in the Buy Box. Merchants choose between grouping by color (with optional swatches) or by size for apparel scenarios. The off-canvas selection panel shows thumbnails, pricing, stock status, and discount flags for each variant. Options include hiding sold-out items and displaying base pricing for unit comparison. This flexibility accommodates simple single-attribute products to complex multi-variant configurations.
